name: World Championships ME - Road Race
story: After France reeled in the 16-rider early breakaway, the race exploded with Mathieu van der Poel, Quinn Simmons and Oscar Onley going clear before Primož Roglič bridged across. Constant attacks followed before a 12-rider group regrouped with 35 kilometres remaining. Brandon McNulty immediately seized his chance and attacked solo, building a lead of over a minute. Despite repeated attacks from the chasers, with Tom Pidcock and Giulio Ciccone coming particularly close on the final lap, McNulty held on by 13 seconds to become world champion ahead of Michael Matthews and Van der Poel.
